$comment: Theme slots: named, swappable micro-interactions a theme pack can replace (webviews/src/slots/registry.ts, docs/cmux-next/extensions/replace-a-slot.md). One entry per slot: its props contract, its motion spec in motion-scale tokens (never raw numbers), its reduced-motion behavior (required), the box every variant must fit (a variant never changes layout), the per-frame budget, and the variants cmux ships. The theme look selects a variant per slot (`slots: { "<slot id>": "<variant id>" }`); without it, or with an id no variant has, a slot draws its default. webviews `check:theme-slots` (scripts/check-theme-slots.ts) holds every variant to this file.

tokens.$comment: What a variant's stylesheet may name for a duration or an easing. Durations: the motion scale (schemas/motion-scale, `--cmux-motion-*`, `--cmux-spinner-period`) and the page loop periods beside it in pages/shared/desktop.css. Easings: the scale's curves, or `linear` / `steps(n)` for a loop.

budget.$comment: The rules every variant of every slot keeps. The check enforces each `enforced` rule on the variant's own files.

rules.rule: Keyframes and transitions change only `transform` and `opacity`: the compositor runs them, the page lays out and paints nothing per frame.

A variant's script starts no frame loop or timer (`requestAnimationFrame`, `setInterval`, `setTimeout`, Web Animations `animate()`, the page clock): all motion is CSS, so its main-thread cost per frame is zero by construction. Props the line already updates (its one-second clock) are the only change over time.
Every animation and transition duration is a `var()` of a duration token above and every easing an easing token or keyword: no `ms`/`s` literal anywhere in a variant's motion.

Every animation sits inside `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)` and under the slot's motion gate, so Reduce Motion, static status indicators and animations off draw the variant's still frame.

No mark fades, blinks or pulses forever (an infinite loop whose keyframes move `opacity`, `visibility` or `scale`): a status mark is still, and a loop moves a mark from place to place instead. webviews test/no-breathing-dots.test.ts holds every shipped stylesheet to it.

A variant fits the slot's box (`box`): the same block size as the default, and an inline size that never changes while it runs. Swapping variants never moves the transcript. Reviewed in the gallery entry, whose layout-shift gate fails a variant that moves.
A loop stops with its condition (`stop`): the slot is drawn only while that holds, and a hidden page pauses every loop (`data-cmux-page-hidden`).

slots.title: Thinking indicator
slots.docs: The agent chat's live line while a turn thinks before it names a step: the word ("Thinking", or the rotating verb) and how it shows the agent is working. Drawn by webviews/src/agent-session/acpmux/conversation/Thinking.tsx inside the line's `<output>`; the line's clock, tokens and counts after it are not the slot's.

label.docs: The words to draw: "Thinking", the turn's rotating verb or the person's custom verb. Already translated.

verbs.docs: Every label the line may rotate through: reserve the widest (the default's `.cv-status-verb` grid does) so a verb change never moves what follows.

elapsed.docs: The time drawn after the slot ("12s"), when the line shows one; the default's light band crosses it too.

elapsedMs.docs: How long the turn has run, updated by the line's existing one-second clock. A variant may change its look past a threshold (more dots as thinking continues); it never starts its own timer.

box.block: The live line's one row (`.cv-worked`, `var(--grid-row)`): a variant draws inside the line's 20px line box and never grows it.
box.inline: The label at its reserved width (the widest of `verbs`) plus at most one mark of a fixed inline size, which never changes while the variant runs.

motion.reducedMotion: Every loop stops and the variant draws its still frame: the word in the line's muted tone and the mark (if any) at full strength, as the default draws the word with no band. Under Reduce Motion, static status indicators (`data-status-indicators="static"`) and animations off (`data-agent-motion="off"`, `data-cmux-motion`).
motion.stop: The slot is drawn only while the turn thinks with no step named: the line changes to the call, "Writing" or the next state, or the turn ends, and the slot unmounts with its loops (the built-in default keeps its one band mounted through a named step: the live line draws it in place). A hidden page pauses it (`data-cmux-page-hidden`); the transcript unmounts rows outside its window.

variants.label: Shimmer
variants.docs: What the line drew before slots, unchanged: a light band in the theme accent sweeps across the dim word and the time. Its two loops are the shared shimmer (conversation.css `.cv-shimmer__*`, `cmux-shimmer-band`/`cmux-shimmer-lit` on `--cmux-shimmer-period`, transform only), which other running rows share, so its rules stay in conversation.css.

variants.label: Counting dots
variants.docs: Three dim dots after the word and a lit dot stepping from one to the next; past twenty seconds a fourth dot joins and the lit dot counts four, so a long think reads as longer.

variants.label: Pulse
variants.docs: One small round mark after the word swells in once as the think starts, then holds still.

variants.label: Caret
variants.docs: A thin caret after the word steps ahead a place at a time, as a cursor typing ahead of the next words; it never blinks.

variants.label: Blocks
variants.docs: Three square cells after the word, a lit block stepping across them a cell at a time: a retro look with no easing.

slots.title: Jump to latest
slots.docs: The mark inside the transcript's Jump to latest button (the glass circle above the composer, shown while the reader is scrolled up from the latest message): how it arrives, rests, answers a press and says the agent is still working. Drawn by webviews/src/agent-session/acpmux/VirtualTranscript.tsx's JumpToLatest inside the button; the button's glass, place, fade, label, focus and click are not the slot's, and the Needs your input pill that replaces it while an ask waits is not either.

shown.docs: The button is on screen. It stays mounted (inert) while hidden, so a variant may play its arrival off `.acpmux-jump-latest[data-shown]`.

working.docs: The agent is working, so new content is still arriving below. A variant may move only while this and `shown` hold.

box.block: The button's 32px circle (`.acpmux-jump-latest`): a variant draws inside it and never resizes it.
box.inline: The same 32px circle; the mark keeps the default's centered `.acpmux-jump-latest__arrow` cell, and moves only by transform inside it.

motion.reducedMotion: No arrival, no press dip and no loop: the variant draws its still frame, the mark at rest in the circle's center at full strength, as the default's static arrow. Under Reduce Motion, static status indicators (`data-status-indicators="static"`) and animations off (`data-agent-motion="off"`, `data-cmux-motion`).
motion.stop: A loop runs only while the button shows (`[data-shown]`) and the agent works: back at the latest message the button hides and every loop stops; a turn's end stops it too. A hidden page pauses it (`data-cmux-page-hidden`).

variants.label: Arrow
variants.docs: What the button drew before slots, unchanged: a static down arrow on the glass's legibility pool (conversation.css `.acpmux-jump-latest__arrow`).

variants.label: Nudge
variants.docs: The arrow drops into the circle on the spring as the button appears, and dips toward the latest message while pressed.

variants.label: Bob
variants.docs: While the agent works, the arrow bobs gently toward the latest message once per breath; idle, it rests. Dips while pressed.

variants.label: Cascade
variants.docs: Two small arrows stacked; while the agent works they rest dim and a lit arrow steps from the upper one to the lower one, a cascade pointing down (by place, never a fade). Dips while pressed.

slots.title: Send transition
slots.docs: A sent prompt's arrival in the transcript: the bubble around the prompt's words, which the send motion brings in (conversation.css SEND-ENTRANCE on `.acpmux-row--message-enter`, `--cmux-motion-send`). Drawn by webviews/src/agent-session/acpmux/conversation/UserBubble.tsx; the row, its attachments, version switcher and footer are not the slot's.

children.docs: The prompt's words (PromptText or InlinePromptContent), drawn inside the bubble.

box.block: The prompt's bubble (`.cv-user__bubble`) at the height its words give it: a variant never adds height or padding.
box.inline: The bubble's width, right-aligned in the row as the default's; a variant moves it only by transform or opacity while it enters.

motion.reducedMotion: The prompt is in place at once with no rise or slide; a fade may stay on the app's fade setting (`--agent-motion-send-fade`). Under Reduce Motion, static status indicators (`data-status-indicators="static"`) and animations off (`data-agent-motion="off"`, `data-cmux-motion`).
motion.stop: The entrance plays once, while the row carries `.acpmux-row--message-enter`, and ends with it; nothing loops.

variants.label: Bubble
variants.docs: What the prompt drew before slots, unchanged: the glass bubble (`ui-glass cv-user__bubble selectable`), entering on the scale's send step (0 today: the prompt lands at once).

slots.title: Receive transition
slots.docs: A reply's arrival in the transcript: the box an agent's reply draws its words in, under the live line while it streams. Drawn by webviews/src/agent-session/acpmux/rows/MessageRow.tsx around RevealedMarkdown; the words' own reveal, the Markdown and the reply's action row are not the slot's.

streaming.docs: The reply is still streaming: its first words have arrived and more are coming. A variant may move only while this holds.

box.block: The reply's height as its words lay out: a variant never adds height or padding.
box.inline: The transcript column's width, as the default's.

motion.reducedMotion: The reply's words appear where they land, with no rise or fade of the slot's own. Under Reduce Motion, static status indicators (`data-status-indicators="static"`) and animations off (`data-agent-motion="off"`, `data-cmux-motion`).
motion.stop: An arrival plays once as the reply mounts, or while `streaming` holds; it ends when the reply finishes. The transcript unmounts rows outside its window.

variants.label: Plain
variants.docs: What a reply drew before slots, unchanged: its words as they are, or in the prompt glass under the Messages presentation (PresentationContext.tsx AssistantPresentation).

slots.title: Side question
slots.docs: The /side interaction: the note a side question opens beside the thread, holding the question and its answer until dismissed. Drawn by webviews/src/agent-session/acpmux/aside/BtwAside.tsx; the head, Dismiss, the question and the answer inside it are not the slot's.

children.docs: The note's head, question and answer (BtwAside.tsx).

label.docs: The note's accessible name ("Side question"), already translated; a variant keeps it on its landmark.

pending.docs: The answer has not come back yet; a variant keeps `aria-busy` on it.

box.block: The note's height as its content lays out (btw.css `.acpmux-btw-note`): a variant never adds height or padding.
box.inline: The note's width in the thread, as the default's.

motion.reducedMotion: The note is in place at once when it opens and gone at once when dismissed. Under Reduce Motion, static status indicators (`data-status-indicators="static"`) and animations off (`data-agent-motion="off"`, `data-cmux-motion`).
motion.stop: An opening plays once as the note mounts; a pending loop stops when the answer or an error comes back, and dismissing unmounts it. A hidden page pauses it (`data-cmux-page-hidden`).

variants.label: Note
variants.docs: What a side question drew before slots, unchanged: the note (btw.css `.acpmux-btw-note`), in place at once.

slots.title: Row hover
slots.docs: A transcript row's hover: the action row a finished reply reveals on hover or keyboard focus (Copy, Pin, Read aloud, Reply, More and its time). Drawn by webviews/src/agent-session/acpmux/conversation/MessageActions.tsx ReplyActions; the buttons and their reveal rules (conversation.css `.acpmux-assistant:hover .cv-reply-actions`) are not the slot's.

box.block: The row's reserved line (`.cv-turn-actions`): it is laid out before the hover, so a reveal never moves the transcript.
box.inline: The reply's width; the buttons keep their places.

motion.reducedMotion: The row shows and hides at once. Under Reduce Motion, static status indicators (`data-status-indicators="static"`) and animations off (`data-agent-motion="off"`, `data-cmux-motion`).
motion.stop: A reveal plays on hover or focus and reverses on leave; nothing loops.

variants.label: Fade in
variants.docs: What the row drew before slots, unchanged: the reserved action line that fades in on hover or focus (conversation.css `--cv-actions-in`).

slots.title: Composer caret
slots.docs: The composer's caret: a mark a variant may draw over the prompt field, beside the field's own caret (styles.css `.acpmux-composer-field`, `caret-color: var(--cmux-caret, ...)`). Drawn by webviews/src/agent-session/acpmux/ComposerBox.tsx after the field; the field, its text and its own caret are not the slot's.

empty.docs: The prompt holds no text (only spaces, or nothing).

box.block: Inside the prompt field's box: a variant draws over it, takes no pointer or focus, and never grows it.
box.inline: Inside the prompt field's box, as the block.

motion.reducedMotion: Any mark is still, at full strength. Under Reduce Motion, static status indicators (`data-status-indicators="static"`) and animations off (`data-agent-motion="off"`, `data-cmux-motion`).
motion.stop: A loop runs only while the field is focused and empty; typing or leaving the field stops it. A hidden page pauses it (`data-cmux-page-hidden`).

variants.label: Field caret
variants.docs: What the composer drew before slots, unchanged: no mark of its own, the field's caret in `--cmux-caret`.

slots.title: Toast enter
slots.docs: A toast's arrival in the stack: what is drawn around the toast's card as it enters. Drawn by webviews/src/ui/NoticeStack.tsx around each Notice; the queue, the timer, the card and the deck's places and fly-in (NoticeDeck.tsx `.ui-notice-deck-card[data-phase]`) are not the slot's.

box.block: The card's height: a variant never adds height or padding.
box.inline: The card's width in the stack.

motion.reducedMotion: The card is in place at once. Under Reduce Motion, static status indicators (`data-status-indicators="static"`) and animations off (`data-agent-motion="off"`, `data-cmux-motion`).
motion.stop: An entrance plays once as the toast mounts; nothing loops. A hidden page pauses it (`data-cmux-page-hidden`).

variants.label: Deck
variants.docs: What a toast drew before slots, unchanged: the card alone, arriving by the deck's own motion.

next.docs: A tab's close button. Pane tabs are drawn natively (Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextTabs), not by a web view, so this slot needs a native host that reads the theme's slot map before it can ship.
